name: Chamber of Atonement
summary: The Chamber of Atonement is the grim entrance hall to the Graveyard wing within the Scarlet Monastery. Here, beneath stone arches hung with iron chains, the Scarlet Crusade subjects captured undead and other perceived heretics to brutal interrogation and torture before casting their remains into the cloister beyond.

sections.title: A Hall of Agony
sections.body: Serving as the threshold to the Forlorn Cloister, the Chamber of Atonement is far from a sanctuary of peaceful prayer. Instead, the Scarlet Crusade has converted the grand entryway into a house of pain, outfitted with racks, shackles, and burning braziers. Zealous inquisitors use these instruments to extract confessions and torment captives, viewing excruciating pain as the only fitting penance for unholy beings. The chamber echoes constantly with the cries of the damned, presided over by cruel taskmasters who ensure that those who enter rarely walk out whole.

sections.title: The Interrogator's Domain
sections.body: The chamber is overseen by Interrogator Vishas, one of the Crusade's most sadistic practitioners of coercion. Vishas takes grotesque pride in breaking the resolve of anyone caught crossing the monastery's boundaries. Among his prized victims is the Forsaken captive Vorrel Sengutz, who has endured endless weeks of torment at Vishas's hands. The cruelty practiced within these walls proves to outsiders that the Scarlet Crusade's crusade for purity has twisted into wanton sadism.

faq.q: What is the Chamber of Atonement used for?
aliases: why are there torture devices here
what happens in chamber of atonement
faq.answer: It serves as the interrogation and torture wing for the Scarlet Crusade inside the Graveyard wing of the monastery. Captives, primarily Forsaken and other perceived enemies, are questioned, broken, and tortured here using brutal implements before their bodies are cast out into the graveyard.
The room is under the command of Interrogator Vishas, a sadistic torturer of the Scarlet Crusade notorious for deriving pleasure from his victims' suffering.

aliases: where does chamber of atonement go
faq.answer: It is the outermost hall of the Graveyard wing and leads directly into the Forlorn Cloister, the open-air cemetery grounds where fallen Crusaders and restless dead reside.

faq.q: Who is being held captive here?
faq.answer: A Forsaken captive named Vorrel Sengutz has been imprisoned and tortured in the chamber by Interrogator Vishas for weeks on end.

angles.text: The Chamber of Atonement represents the height of Scarlet cruelty toward your people, serving as the site where captive Forsaken like Vorrel Sengutz are systematically tortured for existing.
The desecration of holy vows is nowhere more evident than here, where Crusade interrogators twist sacred discipline into physical butchery and sadistic torment.
